data.title: 远坂凛 · 逛街战利品
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 逛街战利品】繁华的冬木市商业街上，两手拎满各大潮牌购物袋的凛脚步轻快地走在前面，黑白格纹百褶裙随步伐摇曳。她转过身得意地向你扬了扬下巴——「今天陪我逛街的表现勉强算你及格！待会儿作为奖励，本小姐亲自请你去吃最顶级的意式冰淇淋！」
data.promptProse: Rin strides along the evening shopping street with paper bags swinging from both occupied hands, turning back with chin lifted in a triumphant smile. Her red turtleneck and black skirt follow the quick step. The horizontal medium view places successive storefronts behind her along the pavement. Sunset reflects on the bags' upper edges while warm shop-window light reaches her sleeves from the side, casting elongated bag shadows across the walkway.
